purpose: n=30 held-out target expansion for the POLIS NLL evaluation (DECISIONS.md, open item 1).
eligibility: complete 33-item UTAS vector + speech dir under repr_speeches_id_organized + not an anchor (152/2377/3631/5520) + not an existing target (1279/2053/2289); 550 eligible, 517 with the >=60 pairs a 30/30 split needs
sampling: 6 log-spaced bands by speech-record count, 5 drawn uniformly per band, random.Random(20260802)
protocol: budget 30 / test 30, matching the committed 1279/2053/2289 runs so old and new pool into one analysis
export: export_polis_dpo_pairs.py --person-id <id> --max-pairs 300 --output-dir data/data/polis/dpo_pairs_targets (prompt/chosen only; no Gemini rejected step -- targets get no adapter of their own)
note: pair yield is ~1:1 with speech records up to the 300 cap (measured 41->40, 81->81, 149->147, 297->297)
